readings: Match laboratory records to patients on ID (dropping lab records with no matching patient) and group by patient ID and sex. For each patient, compute the average WBC, ignoring missing values. Also compute the patient's ratio as the average of the row-level HGB/HCT values, taking HGB divided by HCT on each lab record and then averaging those values, ignoring rows where either is missing. Compute the threshold as the mean of these per-patient ratios across all patients, ignoring patients with a missing ratio. Keep only patients whose ratio is greater than the threshold. Show the patient ID, sex, average WBC, the ratio, and the ratio minus the threshold. Sort by that gap, largest first with missing values last. Return the first 10 rows, with no rounding.

Match laboratory records to patients on ID (dropping lab records with no matching patient) and group by patient ID and sex. For each patient, compute the average WBC, ignoring missing values. Also compute the patient's ratio as the patient's average HGB divided by the patient's average HCT, each averaged separately over non-missing values. Compute the threshold as the mean of these per-patient ratios across all patients, ignoring patients with a missing ratio. Keep only patients whose ratio is greater than the threshold. Show the patient ID, sex, average WBC, the ratio, and the ratio minus the threshold. Sort by that gap, largest first with missing values last. Return the first 10 rows, with no rounding.
queries:
WITH per_patient AS (
    SELECT
        P.ID AS ID,
        P.SEX AS SEX,
        AVG(L.WBC) AS avg_wbc,
        AVG(CASE WHEN L.HGB IS NOT NULL AND L.HCT IS NOT NULL THEN L.HGB * 1.0 / L.HCT END) AS ratio
    FROM Laboratory L
    JOIN Patient P ON L.ID = P.ID
    GROUP BY P.ID, P.SEX
),
threshold AS (
    SELECT AVG(ratio) AS thr FROM per_patient WHERE ratio IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    pp.ID,
    pp.SEX,
    pp.avg_wbc,
    pp.ratio,
    pp.ratio - t.thr AS gap
FROM per_patient pp
CROSS JOIN threshold t
WHERE pp.ratio > t.thr
ORDER BY gap DESC
LIMIT 10;
WITH per AS (
  SELECT l.ID AS ID, p.SEX AS SEX, AVG(l.WBC) AS avg_wbc,
         AVG(l.HGB) * 1.0 / AVG(l.HCT) AS ratio
  FROM Laboratory l
  JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID
  GROUP BY l.ID, p.SEX
),
th AS (
  SELECT AVG(ratio) AS threshold FROM per WHERE ratio IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT per.ID, per.SEX, per.avg_wbc, per.ratio, per.ratio - th.threshold AS gap
FROM per, th
WHERE per.ratio > th.threshold
ORDER BY gap DESC
LIMIT 10;
